description:
[Game reference] Every gesture: console name, unlock (free, pack, DLC, admin), length and limits. `gestures`: one per gesture - `command` (the console name: `bind g "gesture <command>"`), `name`, `desc`
(`desc_source` "game" = Facepunch's text, "rust.wiki" = ours), `unlock` (`type` free / steam_item (an Item Store pack,
with `itemdefid` + `name`) / dlc (`appid` + `name`) / cinematic = admins, or everyone with server.cinematic on),
`unlock_text`, `unlock_url`, `duration_s`, `loops`, `full_body` (can't be used mounted, swimming or crouched),
`can_move`, `in_wheel` (false = the game plays it for you), `two_player`, `bind` (a ready bind line). `command` is what goes in a bind: bind g "gesture <command>". Link https://rust.wiki/gestures.
name: get_gestures
title: Every gesture: console name, unlock (free, pack, DLC, admin), length and limits
